stage_2_story.text_en: David and his seventeen-year-old son, Yoni, had been having disagreements for weeks. Yoni wanted to stay out late with his friends, but David expressed concern about his safety and his school performance. One evening, they sat down at the kitchen table to resolve the issue calmly. David shared his advice based on his own experience as a young man. Yoni listened, then explained how much he valued his independence and the trust of his father. They reached a compromise — Yoni would come home by eleven on weekends, and in return, David would give him more responsibility to manage his own time during the week. Both of them accepted the terms. David reminded his son that guidance is not control, and Yoni acknowledged his father's support. They reconciled that evening with a handshake and a shared cup of tea. From that point forward, their relationship grew stronger.
